children: Natuzzi says a €17.5M reserved capital increase was subscribed and fully paid on November 26, 2026, through reclassified shareholder loans, with no further cash contribution. Shareholders also authorized rights issues of up to €15.0M and €65.0M by June 30, 2027.
Adds shares for INVEST, but was funded through reclassified shareholder loans rather than new cash.
Rights issues authorized: up to €15.0M and €65.0M
Potential future equity funding could strengthen capital and support restructuring, but execution, pricing and timing remain open.
The planned rights issue is intended to help regain compliance with NYSE market-capitalization or equity standards; no outcome is assured.
Minority rights issue requires payment by June 30, 2027
INVEST's limited waiver is conditional and allows minority holders to restore prior ownership percentages only upon full subscription.

This is a capital-structure and restructuring update amid Natuzzi's effort to address an NYSE delisting determination. The next catalysts are registration of the resolutions and the Board's decisions on rights-issue terms, timing and completion before the stated deadlines.
Based on the original press release from Natuzzi S.p.A. distributed by BusinessWire.
